mechanism.claim: During elevated BTC variation, unusually strong low-frequency cross-spectral coherence between completed five-minute quote turnover and signed returns identifies a displacement organized by persistent participation rather than isolated price noise. When the completed block and final two hours agree, follow that sponsored direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVLFE measures return-spectrum energy alone; HVTLRR estimates one-bar turnover-to-next-return correlation; HVTVLR compares turnover and variation time centroids; flow candidates use signed taker imbalance. HVRVSC measures the normalized complex cross-spectrum of unsigned quote turnover and signed return across fixed low-frequency bins. It reuses no event set or control and uses no spot count, funding, OI, premium, fitted outcome, or post-entry data.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35 percent and return-volume low-frequency coherence its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: 03:05/11:05/19:05 UTC spectral-coherence onsets are absent from Gross9 clocks

features.block: 96 exact epoch-aligned five-minute aggregates from 480 unique coherent BTCUSDT perpetual one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.five_minute_turnover: sum finite nonnegative quote_asset_volume over five constituents; block sum strict positive
features.coordinates: demean the 96 signed returns and demean log1p five-minute turnover separately
features.spectrum: numpy rfft of each demeaned coordinate
features.low_frequency_cross_spectrum: sum V_k*conj(R_k) for fixed non-DC bins k=1..8
features.spectral_coherence: absolute low_frequency_cross_spectrum divided by sqrt(sum(k=1..8)|V_k|^2 * sum(k=1..8)|R_k|^2); both energies strict positive; finite in [0,1]
features.coherence_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared five-minute returns), finite strict positive
features.late_return: sum final 24 five-minute returns, strict nonzero and same sign as block_return
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding scheduled source-valid decision ineligible; missing or invalid prior cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent frequency-domain participation sponsorship mechanism selected from formula and complete-source audit only

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no aggregation, transform, bins, coherence, history, rank, threshold, variation, confirmation, onset, clock, hold, side, subset, source, or control repair
